mathematical_definition: (pi/2) * causal_rolling_mean(|ret1_t| * |ret1_{t-1}|, window=60) -- Barndorff-Nielsen & Shephard bipower variation, robust to jumps
numerical_stability_notes: pi/2 is the (E|Z|)^-2 BNS scaling constant for a standard normal
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first bar (no t-1 return to pair with), and for windows with fewer than 60 observed bars
